description.narrative: A senior sovereign-guaranteed loan of up to EUR 300 million in favour of JSC "Ukrainian Railways" (the "Company" or "UZ"). The Loan will finance acquisition of electric locomotives and consist of two tranches: (i) EUR 120 million committed Tranche 1 and (ii) EUR 180 million uncommitted Tranche 2. The operation will enable the Company to address its critical needs to renew its operating fleet, to maintain operations and ensure stable and uninterrupted railway cargo (including logistics for the agricultural exports and critical imports) and passenger transportation services, despite the devastating impact of the war on Ukraine. In the current crisis environment triggered by the war on Ukraine, the emergency capex program covering acquisition of electric locomotives will support the Company in addressing its critical operating fleet renewal and ensuring continuity of its operations. Provision of essential railway cargo and passenger transportation services remains critical for the Ukrainian population, the Ukrainian economy and continued functioning of the private sector, as well as for humanitarian efforts.
